metadata.description: Customer identifier — lowercase, alphanumeric, max 20 chars
Company display name
Region for the Cosmos DB account only. Defaults to azureRegion; override when the primary region has Cosmos capacity constraints (both values remain EU per R1).

SAD §22.1 (SR-007) — Continuous Backup (point-in-time restore, self-service) vs. Periodic (240min/8h, Azure Support restore only). Continuous is the decided default. Migrating an existing account from Periodic to Continuous is supported in place but is one-way — see modules/cosmos-db.bicep header.
Azure OpenAI deployment region — hard-pinned per ADR-001 until DataZoneStandard quota exists elsewhere. Never wire azureRegion into openAiModule.
App Service Plan SKU. B1 is validation-environment only — never use for a production customer.

H-2 — restrict App Service ingress to Cloudflare IP ranges only. Default true for all customers; must be false ONLY for the documented val1 exception (unproxied, App Service-managed cert) — see modules/app-service.bicep header and docs/known-limitations.md. Never set false for a production customer.
H-5 (SAD §31.2) — alert action group email receiver.

H-5 (SAD §31.2) — monthly cost budget baseline for the Microsoft.Consumption/budgets alert, in the subscription billing currency. See modules/alerts.bicep for why this is monthly, not the SAD's literal daily-baseline wording.
Deployment environment tag. "validation" is for internal test stacks only — never a paying customer.
Azure OpenAI deployment SKU — GDPR R2: DataZoneStandard only, never GlobalStandard.
Override the tier-mapped chat model name. Leave empty to use the ADR-001 tier default.
Override the tier-mapped chat model version. Leave empty to use the ADR-001 tier default.
Override the tier-mapped chat model capacity (1K TPM units). Leave 0 to use the ADR-001 tier default.
Embedding model name — GA per ADR-001 (text-embedding-3-small until the -large quota grant lands).
Embedding model version.
Embedding model deployment capacity (1K TPM units).

Embedding vector width — must match embeddingModelName AND the AI Search index vectorSearchDimensions (ADR-001: locked at provisioning; 1536 for text-embedding-3-small, 3072 for text-embedding-3-large). Keep in sync with embeddingModelName when overriding either.
Azure OpenAI REST API version consumed by src/features/common/services/azure-ai.ts (AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION).
Azure AI Search index name for this customer (AZURE_SEARCH_INDEX_NAME).
Log Analytics / Application Insights retention in days (SAD §31.6). GDPR-minimum is 30.
Azure OpenAI deployment SKU — GDPR R2: DataZoneStandard only, never GlobalStandard.
Override the tier-mapped chat model name. Leave empty to use the ADR-001 tier default.
Override the tier-mapped chat model version. Leave empty to use the ADR-001 tier default.
Override the tier-mapped chat model capacity (1K TPM units). Leave 0 to use the ADR-001 tier default.
Embedding model name — GA per ADR-001 (text-embedding-3-small until the -large quota grant lands).
Embedding model version.
Embedding model deployment capacity (1K TPM units).
Zone redundancy for the Cosmos account. Default false per SAD §34.5 (single-region MVP); westeurope zonal capacity is also frequently constrained.

SAD §22.1 — Continuous Backup (point-in-time restore, self-service, 30-day window) vs. Periodic (240min interval, 8h retention, Azure Support restore only). Continuous is the decided default; migration from Periodic is one-way.

SQL API database name. Must match src/features/common/services/cosmos.ts AZURE_COSMOSDB_DB_NAME default ("chat") — app-service.bicep does not currently set that app setting, so the code default is authoritative.

Chat-history container name. Must match cosmos.ts AZURE_COSMOSDB_CONTAINER_NAME default ("history"). Holds ChatThreadModel/ChatMessageModel/ChatDocumentModel/ChatCitationModel, partitioned on the end-user id.

Tenant-config container name. Must match cosmos.ts AZURE_COSMOSDB_CONFIG_CONTAINER_NAME default ("config"). Holds TenantTheme/ModuleConfig/UserAccount/CustomerEntity/MeetingBriefDocument/ActivityEvent/GDPR erasure audit records — all keyed, per established convention, on tenantSlug stored in the /userId path (never an end-user id).

Azure OpenAI resource name (NOT the endpoint URL) — azure-ai.ts requireEnv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_INSTANCE_NAME").
Azure OpenAI REST API version — azure-ai.ts AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION.
Chat model deployment name — azure-ai.ts AZURE_OPENAI_CHAT_DEPLOYMENT.
Embedding model deployment name — azure-ai.ts AZURE_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_DEPLOYMENT.
Embedding vector width — azure-ai.ts AZURE_OPENAI_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS.
Azure AI Search resource name (NOT the endpoint URL) — ai-search.ts AZURE_SEARCH_NAME.
Azure AI Search index name — ai-search.ts / azure-ai-search.ts AZURE_SEARCH_INDEX_NAME.
Cosmos DB endpoint URI — cosmos.ts AZURE_COSMOSDB_URI.
Key Vault name (NOT the endpoint URL) — key-vault.ts AZURE_KEY_VAULT_NAME.
Key Vault URI (e.g. https://kv-azurechat-{slug}.vault.azure.net/) — SR-001: used to build Key Vault reference app-setting values below. Never a secret itself.
Storage account name — azure-storage.ts AZURE_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME.
Document Intelligence endpoint URL — document-intelligence.ts AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT.
Customer slug echoed back as TENANT_SLUG — src/features/theme/tenant-resolver.ts fallback when the Host header is not a recognized {slug}-sales360 subdomain.
Azure AI Speech region — proposed contract: AZURE_SPEECH_REGION, consumed by the speech token-issuing API route.
Azure AI Speech account full ARM resource ID — proposed contract: AZURE_SPEECH_RESOURCE_ID (never a key).
Azure AI Speech account endpoint URL — proposed contract: AZURE_SPEECH_ENDPOINT.

H-2 — restrict App Service ingress to Cloudflare IP ranges only (default-deny otherwise). Must be false only for an explicitly documented exception (see val1 in known-limitations.md); true for every production customer.
Action group email receiver. Default matches CLAUDE.md/task default.
Microsoft.Web/sites resource id (app-azurechat-{slug}) — used for the availability webtest target URL.
Microsoft.Web/serverfarms resource id (plan-azurechat-{slug}) — CPU alert scope.
Microsoft.Insights/components resource id (appi-azurechat-{slug}) — availability + HTTP 5xx log-query alert scope.
Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts resource id (oai-azurechat-{slug}).
Chat model deployment capacity, 1K TPM units (modules/openai.bicep output).
Embedding model deployment capacity, 1K TPM units.
Microsoft.DocumentDB/databaseAccounts resource id (cosmos-azurechat-{slug}).
Microsoft.Search/searchServices resource id (srch-azurechat-{slug}).

SAD §17 monthly Azure cost estimate for this customer tier, in the subscription billing currency — used as the Microsoft.Consumption/budgets baseline. NOT a literal daily figure; see the budget resource comment below for why "150% of daily baseline" cannot be expressed natively as a per-resource-group ARM resource.
First day of the current month (yyyy-MM-01) — Microsoft.Consumption/budgets requires an explicit timePeriod.startDate and rejects inline utcNow() outside a parameter default.

properties.description: SAD §31.2 — App Service availability < 99% over 5 minutes (via Application Insights availability test).
SAD §31.2 — HTTP 5xx rate > 5% over 5 minutes. Requires SR-010 telemetry (Application Insights requests table) to be flowing.

allOf.query: requests | summarize total = count(), errors = countif(toint(resultCode) >= 500) | extend pct = iff(total == 0, 0.0, 100.0 * todouble(errors) / todouble(total)) | project pct
